description: Polyglot monorepo for a long session: Python stdlib pricing service, Node ESM web BFF with a 3,000-line legacy router, shared JSON contract, bash scripts, a 25,000-line production log, roadmap specs for a Go ledger (Docker only), contract v3, log report, router refactor, CI and release 3.0.0. generators/ rebuilds the log, the legacy router, the golden file and the p3 cross-language cases deterministically.
